title: A telegram from González Garza to Braulio Hernández, 27 March 1911 (CEHM-Carso CMXV.15.1420.3-6): a letter-swap key read by William Echols

documents.shelfmark: CEHM-Carso, Fondo CMXV (Archivo Federico González Garza), CMXV.15.1420.3-6
documents.route: Federico González Garza (El Paso, Texas) -> Braulio Hernández (Presidio, Texas)

plaintext.source: The CEHM card says texto en clave and gives no decipherment; the contributor found none.

transcription.source: the contributor's transcription of the two CEHM images; the project did not see them
transcription.notes: A short telegram; four words are coded and the rest is clear Spanish.

system.summary: Five pairs of letters swap in place in both directions (L-A, N-E, R-I, S-O, T-U); every other letter is unchanged; four words of a Spanish telegram are coded.

prior_solution.where: The key card for the recipient (CMXV.16.1557.1, scan 16) in the same fonds gives the pairs; no decipherment of this telegram stands on the sheet and the contributor found none in print.

conditions.human_role: William Echols submitted the transcription, the key and the reading (issue #351), made with GPT-6.1 Sol in Codex. The project re-ran the four decryptions; it has not seen the scans or the card.

solution.what: The contributor transcribed the two CEHM images; the project did not see them.
The contributor applied the five letter pairs of the Hernández key card (CMXV.16.1557.1, scan 16) to the four coded words: all four give Spanish words (VILLARREAL, SALDRA, LLEVANDO, CANON).
Project check: the four coded words decrypted again with the five pairs agree with the contributor's decryption on all 29 letters (VERIFICATION.md). No scan or card compared.

validation.notes: Four coded words are too few for a language-model test, and the key is the archive's card, not a recovered key.

outcome.method_basis: The key is the archive's own card for the recipient, found in the same fonds by the contributor and applied; the project re-ran the four decryptions. The key was not recovered from the ciphertext.

credits.note: transcription, key card and reading of CMXV.15.1420.3-6; issue #351

gaps.item: a human check of the transcription and of the key card against the CEHM scans
gaps.detail: cehm.org.mx is not reachable from the project and the images may not be redistributed

gaps.item: whether the telegram is already in print (Narváez 2011 and 2019, the recipients' papers)
gaps.detail: the contributor reports none found; the project did not search these books

outcome.notes: Transcription, key card and reading by William Echols; checked by the project against his submission only, not against the scans.
outcome.fraction_read_source: Counted from decryption.txt: all 4 coded words, 29 of 29 letters, decrypt to Spanish words.

texts.label: Telegram of 27 March 1911 to Braulio Hernández (CEHM-Carso CMXV.15.1420.3-6)
texts.summary: A telegram from Federico González Garza at El Paso to Braulio Hernández at Presidio: did you receive the pills? you should stay there; Villarreal will leave Wednesday or Thursday, taking a cannon; write back.

reading_review.note: Read the telegram as Spanish sentences: the four decoded words fill the gaps of the clear text and make coherent clauses; the transcription is the contributor's and was not compared with the scan.
